title: New Hoffman–Levin collaboration on recursive trace logic
summary: Donald Hoffman tells of New Hoffman–Levin collaboration on recursive trace logic, about present (2026) at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Actually we're just now starting up a collaboration. we're going to get a postto together because of the trace logic um this recursive trace logic

plain: A scientist named Donald Hoffman says that in 2026 he is just starting a collaboration with another researcher, Mike Levin, built around a mathematical idea he calls recursive trace logic. He says they plan to bring on a postdoctoral researcher to work on it together. It ties into Hoffman's broader view that our senses hide much of what is really out there.
